mapper.select: SELECT p.quantity,p.source_document_id,b.owner_id,b.location_id,b.sku_id,b.lot_id,b.quality_code FROM stock_posting p JOIN stock_ledger l ON l.enterprise_id=p.enterprise_id AND l.warehouse_id=p.warehouse_id AND l.operation_id=p.command_id AND l.entry_no=1 AND l.on_hand_delta=p.quantity AND l.reason_code='RECEIVE' JOIN stock_balance b ON b.id=l.balance_id AND b.enterprise_id=l.enterprise_id AND b.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id WHERE p.enterprise_id=#{ent} AND p.warehouse_id=#{wh} AND p.source_service='wms-inbound' AND p.command_id=#{receipt} AND p.action='RECEIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_receipt_quality (id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,receipt_command_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{ent},#{wh},#{receipt},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,receipt_command_id,source_version,accepted_qty,rejected_qty,putaway_qty,version FROM stock_receipt_quality WHERE enterprise_id=#{ent} AND warehouse_id=#{wh} AND receipt_command_id=#{receipt} FOR UPDATE
